title.fa: مارکسیسم به‌عنوان راززدایی — و حکم ۱۹۶۹ گومبروویچ
title.en: Marxism as demystification — and Gombrowicz’s 1969 verdict
title.nl: Marxism as demystification — and Gombrowicz’s 1969 verdict

summary.fa: گومبروویچ مارکسیسم را در کنار فرویدیسم و نیچه می‌گذارد: هر سه اسطوره‌زدایی می‌کنند. شرح او از نظریه روشن و منصفانه است، و بعد با صراحت رد می‌کند — به دلیلی اقتصادی، نه اخلاقی. حکم او دربارهٔ آیندهٔ مارکسیسم، گفته‌شده در ۱۹۶۹، به خودی خود سندی تاریخی است.
summary.en: Gombrowicz places Marxism beside Freudianism and Nietzsche: all three demystify. His exposition of the theory is clear and fair, and then he rejects it bluntly — on economic rather than moral grounds. His verdict on Marxism’s future, delivered in 1969, is itself a historical document.
summary.nl: Gombrowicz places Marxism beside Freudianism and Nietzsche: all three demystify. His exposition of the theory is clear and fair, and then he rejects it bluntly — on economic rather than moral grounds. His verdict on Marxism’s future, delivered in 1969, is itself a historical document.

text.fa: هستهٔ نظریه به روایت او: «مصدر قدرت هیچ نیست جز استثمار، و آن‌چه از شکل افتاده همانا آگاهی ماست — زیرا آگاهی ما با نظام استثماری سازگاری یافته ولی حاضر نیست به آن اعتراف کند.» مارکسیسم تلاشی است برای راززدایی.
text.en: The theory’s core as he puts it: "the source of power is nothing but exploitation, and what is deformed is our consciousness — because our consciousness has adapted to the exploitative order and will not admit it." Marxism is an attempt at demystification.
text.nl: The theory’s core as he puts it: "the source of power is nothing but exploitation, and what is deformed is our consciousness — because our consciousness has adapted to the exploitative order and will not admit it." Marxism is an attempt at demystification.

text.fa: کاری که مذهب، اخلاقیات، فلسفه و قانون می‌کنند: مذهب اقتدار را مقرر از جانب خدا می‌نمایاند و عدالت را به جهانی دیگر موکول می‌کند — «معنای عمیق و یگانهٔ مذهب به ساده‌ترین کلام موکول کردن عدالت به جهانی دیگر است». اخلاقیات رایج عمدتاً متوجه حفظ حق مالکیت است، و قانون نظامی است که می‌خواهد حق مالکیت و بهره‌کشی را مستحکم کند.
text.en: What religion, morality, philosophy and law do: religion presents authority as ordained by God and defers justice to another world — "the single deepest meaning of religion, put most simply, is the deferral of justice to another world." Prevailing morality is aimed mainly at preserving property, and law is a system meant to entrench property and exploitation.
text.nl: What religion, morality, philosophy and law do: religion presents authority as ordained by God and defers justice to another world — "the single deepest meaning of religion, put most simply, is the deferral of justice to another world." Prevailing morality is aimed mainly at preserving property, and law is a system meant to entrench property and exploitation.

text.fa: و فلسفه: «ماهیت فلسفه ریشه در نگرشی تأملی دارد. فلسفه نمی‌خواهد دنیا را عوض کند؛ فلسفه به متافیزیک پناه می‌برد. کوتاه سخن این‌که فلسفه خردی است که از بنیاد خود جدا افتاده است، روبنایی است که تلاش می‌کند وابستگی خود را مخفی نگاه دارد.»
text.en: And philosophy: "philosophy is contemplative by nature. It does not want to change the world; it takes refuge in metaphysics. In short, philosophy is a reason cut off from its own base, a superstructure that tries to hide its dependence."
text.nl: And philosophy: "philosophy is contemplative by nature. It does not want to change the world; it takes refuge in metaphysics. In short, philosophy is a reason cut off from its own base, a superstructure that tries to hide its dependence."

text.fa: قرابت سه‌گانه: «مارکسیسم، درست همانند فرویدیسم یا نیچه، اسطوره‌ها را برملا می‌کند.» و امتیاز نیچه در همین زمینه این بود که نشان داد ذهن ما از همان ماده‌ای ساخته شده که تمام چیزهای دیگر از آن ساخته شده‌اند.
text.en: A threefold kinship: "Marxism, exactly like Freudianism or Nietzsche, exposes myths." And Nietzsche’s merit here was to show that our mind is made of the same matter as everything else.
text.nl: A threefold kinship: "Marxism, exactly like Freudianism or Nietzsche, exposes myths." And Nietzsche’s merit here was to show that our mind is made of the same matter as everything else.

text.fa: ارزش افزوده به بیان ساده: کارفرما نیروی کار را کالا می‌بیند و به حداقل قیمت می‌خرد؛ «کارگر همیشه بیش از آن‌چه حقوق می‌گیرد کالا تولید می‌کند» و آن اضافه به جیب سرمایه‌دار می‌رود. نتیجه بیگانگی است: «انسان بیگانه‌شده، یعنی انسانی که نمی‌تواند خودش باشد و ناچار است به‌عوض برخورداری از زندگی عادی مثل ماشین کار کند.»
text.en: Surplus value in plain terms: the employer sees labour power as a commodity and buys it at the minimum price; "the worker always produces more goods than his wage" and the surplus goes to the capitalist. The result is alienation: "alienated man is a man who cannot be himself and must work like a machine instead of having an ordinary life."
text.nl: Surplus value in plain terms: the employer sees labour power as a commodity and buys it at the minimum price; "the worker always produces more goods than his wage" and the surplus goes to the capitalist. The result is alienation: "alienated man is a man who cannot be himself and must work like a machine instead of having an ordinary life."

text.fa: دو مرحلهٔ تحقق به روایت او: نخست دیکتاتوری پرولتاریا — «دیکتاتوری و نه دموکراسی»، با ملی‌کردن ابزار تولید و محدود کردن آزادی‌های فردی، و حقوق بر اساس خدمات. سپس مرحله‌ای که انحلال تدریجی دولت و سازمان‌های تعاونی کوچک است، با حقوق بر اساس احتیاج. گومبروویچ مرحلهٔ دوم را «مرحلهٔ حماقت‌بار» و «روژیای ارواح شریف» می‌خواند.
text.en: The two stages of realization as he tells them: first the dictatorship of the proletariat — "dictatorship, not democracy" — with the means of production nationalized, individual liberties restricted, and pay according to service. Then a stage of the gradual dissolution of the state into small cooperatives, with pay according to need. Gombrowicz calls the second stage "the idiotic stage" and "the utopia of noble souls."
text.nl: The two stages of realization as he tells them: first the dictatorship of the proletariat — "dictatorship, not democracy" — with the means of production nationalized, individual liberties restricted, and pay according to service. Then a stage of the gradual dissolution of the state into small cooperatives, with pay according to need. Gombrowicz calls the second stage "the idiotic stage" and "the utopia of noble souls."

text.fa: و تعریف فلسفی خودش از مارکسیسم: «مارکسیسم یک ایدئولوژی یا یک حقیقت نیست، بلکه صرفاً آزادی از قید نیازهای انسانی به‌عنوان سرچشمهٔ ارزش‌هاست»، و «مارکسیسم نه دگرگونی مفاهیم که دگرگونی انسان‌هایی معین است». پراکسیس یعنی کردار آگاهانه و عملی؛ هر نظریه‌ای که تجسم عینی نیابد محال است.
text.en: And his own philosophical definition: "Marxism is not an ideology or a truth but simply liberation from human needs as the source of values," and "Marxism is not a transformation of concepts but of particular human beings." Praxis means conscious practical action; any theory that fails to be embodied is impossible.
text.nl: And his own philosophical definition: "Marxism is not an ideology or a truth but simply liberation from human needs as the source of values," and "Marxism is not a transformation of concepts but of particular human beings." Praxis means conscious practical action; any theory that fails to be embodied is impossible.

text.fa: ایراد اصلی او اقتصادی است نه اخلاقی: «به نظر من پرسش مارکسیست‌ها کاملاً بد مطرح شده، زیرا آن را از منظر اخلاقیِ عدالت مطرح کردند. اما مسئلهٔ واقعی نه اخلاقی بلکه اقتصادی است. افزایش ثروت در درجهٔ اول اهمیت قرار دارد و توزیع ثروت امری است ثانوی.» و می‌افزاید مارکسیست‌ها پرسش را اخلاقی مطرح می‌کنند چون آسان‌تر است و امکان ساختن جملات دلنشین می‌دهد.
text.en: His main objection is economic, not moral: "in my view the Marxists put the question entirely wrongly, because they put it in the moral terms of justice. But the real problem is not moral but economic. Increasing wealth comes first; distributing wealth is secondary." And he adds that they frame it morally because that is easier and allows for pleasant sentences.
text.nl: His main objection is economic, not moral: "in my view the Marxists put the question entirely wrongly, because they put it in the moral terms of justice. But the real problem is not moral but economic. Increasing wealth comes first; distributing wealth is secondary." And he adds that they frame it morally because that is easier and allows for pleasant sentences.

text.fa: بحران مارکسیسم در ۱۹۶۹ به تشخیص او: «همان‌گونه که تجربهٔ بلوک شرق نشان داده است، فرد بد کار می‌کند و تولیدش بسیار ناچیز می‌شود. اما چرا؟ زیرا زندگی دشوار است؛ اگر انسان‌ها را مجبور به کار نکنند، طبیعتاً کار نمی‌کنند.» یعنی ایراد او مسئلهٔ انگیزه است.
text.en: Marxism’s crisis in 1969 as he diagnoses it: "as the experience of the Eastern bloc has shown, the individual works badly and his output becomes very small. But why? Because life is hard; if people are not made to work, naturally they do not." His objection is the problem of incentives.
text.nl: Marxism’s crisis in 1969 as he diagnoses it: "as the experience of the Eastern bloc has shown, the individual works badly and his output becomes very small. But why? Because life is hard; if people are not made to work, naturally they do not." His objection is the problem of incentives.

text.fa: پیش‌بینی او: «به ظن من، ظرف بیست یا سی سال آینده همه از مارکسیسم رویگردان خواهند شد.» و در مقابل، اگر پیشرفت تکنولوژیک ادامه یابد «می‌تواند ظرف بیست یا سی سال جهان را از بنیاد دگرگون کند». این‌ها در مه ۱۹۶۹ گفته شده‌اند.
text.en: His prediction: "in my estimation, within the next twenty or thirty years everyone will turn away from Marxism." And in contrast, if technological progress continues it "could fundamentally transform the world within twenty or thirty years." These words were spoken in May 1969.
text.nl: His prediction: "in my estimation, within the next twenty or thirty years everyone will turn away from Marxism." And in contrast, if technological progress continues it "could fundamentally transform the world within twenty or thirty years." These words were spoken in May 1969.

text.fa: یک ریزبینی زبانی در همین بحث: او می‌گوید چپ واژه‌ها را تحریف کرده — «منظور از کارگر پزشکی نیست که از صبح تا شب سخت کار می‌کند، بلکه منظور رفتگری است که پنج دقیقه کار می‌کند و سپس به دیوارها نگاه می‌کند». و می‌افزاید «چپ‌گرایان نمی‌فهمند که خودشان نیز اشراف‌زاده‌اند و نخستین کاری که انقلاب انجام می‌دهد تصفیه کردن خود آن‌هاست؛ یعنی همان اتفاقی که در لهستان روی داد».
text.en: A point about language in the same discussion: he says the left has distorted words — "by ‘worker’ they do not mean a doctor who works hard from morning to night, but a street-sweeper who works five minutes and then looks at the walls." And he adds that "leftists do not understand that they are aristocrats too, and the first thing a revolution does is purge them — which is exactly what happened in Poland."
text.nl: A point about language in the same discussion: he says the left has distorted words — "by ‘worker’ they do not mean a doctor who works hard from morning to night, but a street-sweeper who works five minutes and then looks at the walls." And he adds that "leftists do not understand that they are aristocrats too, and the first thing a revolution does is purge them — which is exactly what happened in Poland."

text.fa: «فاشیسم نوعی انقلاب رو به عقب است» — تمام آن‌چه در این درس‌ها دربارهٔ فاشیسم آمده همین یک جمله است.
text.en: "Fascism is a kind of revolution in reverse" — this single sentence is all the lectures say about fascism.
text.nl: "Fascism is a kind of revolution in reverse" — this single sentence is all the lectures say about fascism.

text.fa: این مدخل حکم‌های سیاسی و اقتصادیِ یک رمان‌نویس در سال ۱۹۶۹ را گزارش می‌کند، نه تحلیل اقتصادی؛ او برای هیچ‌یک از این احکام داده یا منبعی نمی‌آورد، و درس‌ها اشاره‌های تاریخ‌گذشته و خامی هم دربارهٔ کشورها و گروه‌های انسانی دارند که در این مدخل به کار نرفته‌اند.
text.en: This entry reports a novelist’s political and economic verdicts from 1969, not an economic analysis; he offers no data or sources for any of them, and the lectures also contain dated and crude asides about countries and groups of people that are not used here.
